title: Reduced-Order Model Characterization of Nonlinear Sustained Oscillations
summary: Nonlinear sustained oscillations involving inverter-based resources can happen when device and network interactions produce an attracting limit cycle around an unstable equilibrium. A damping controller must then describe nonlinear dynamics over the region between the two invariant sets, where a local equilibrium linearization can be insufficient. In this paper, a controlled phase--isostable model is first developed on a two-dimensional invariant manifold connecting the equilibrium and the limit cycle.
